During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]] created a '''task force''' in order to rescue Republic forces trapped on [[Lola Sayu]]. The [[task force]] consisted of four [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] that participated in the [[Battle of Lola Sayu]], although one received heavy damage and no longer took part in the battle. Additionally,<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> [[squadron]]s<ref name="Citadel Rescue AD">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170 starfighters]] were used on all Star Destroyers, as well as at least one [[space gunship]]. The task force was led by four [[Jedi General]]s; [[Plo Koon]], [[Saesee Tiin]], [[Adi Gallia]], and [[Kit Fisto]] alongside [[Admiral]] [[Barton Coburn]]. Additionally, the task forces' ground units included the [[104th Battalion]], which crewed at least one of the Star Destroyers.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" />
